user.title: Sungrow EMS
user.description: Connect to your Sungrow hybrid inverter and, optionally, the iHomeManager over local Modbus TCP. No cloud account is used and everything stays on your local network.

data_description.inverter_host: IP address or hostname of the inverter's WiNet-S / LAN Modbus TCP interface.
data_description.inverter_port: Modbus TCP port of the inverter. Default 502.
data_description.inverter_device_id: Modbus unit (slave) ID of the inverter. Default 1.
data_description.ihm_enabled: Poll the iHomeManager for grid, load, battery totals and the EV charger.
data_description.ihm_host: IP address or hostname of the iHomeManager. Required when the iHomeManager is enabled.
data_description.ihm_port: The iHM listens on 502, 503 and 504 and allows ONE connection per port. Default 503. Use 504 while another integration still holds 503.
data_description.ihm_device_id: Fixed at 247 by the iHM protocol. Only change this if Sungrow support tells you to.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Sungrow EMS
reconfigure.description: Change hosts, ports or unit IDs. The inverter serial number must stay the same.

data_description.inverter_host: IP address or hostname of the inverter's WiNet-S / LAN Modbus TCP interface.
data_description.inverter_port: Modbus TCP port of the inverter. Default 502.
data_description.inverter_device_id: Modbus unit (slave) ID of the inverter. Default 1.

data_description.ihm_host: IP address or hostname of the iHomeManager. Required when the iHomeManager is enabled.
data_description.ihm_port: The iHM listens on 502, 503 and 504 and allows ONE connection per port. Default 503. Use 504 while another integration still holds 503.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the inverter. Check the host, port and that nothing else holds the connection.
error.not_sungrow: The device answered but rejected the Sungrow identity registers. Check the unit ID.
error.no_serial: The inverter did not report a serial number (registers 4990-4999).
error.ihm_host_required: Enter the iHomeManager host, or turn off "Use iHomeManager".
error.ihm_cannot_connect: Could not connect to the iHomeManager. It allows one connection per port: try port 504 while another integration uses 503.
error.not_ihm: The device on that port is not an iHomeManager (device type code is not 0x072A).
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different inverter (serial number changed). Add it as a new entry instead.

init.title: Sungrow EMS options
init.description: Polling, reliability and energy model settings. Saving reloads the integration.

data.spike_max_daily: Spike filter: largest plausible daily total
data.spike_rebaseline_count: Spike filter: readings needed to accept a new baseline

data_description.inverter_scan_interval: Seconds between inverter polls. 10 s is the recommended default.
data_description.ihm_scan_interval: Seconds between iHomeManager polls. Each poll makes about 3 requests spaced by the minimum gap, so keep this at 10 s or more.
data_description.timeout: Seconds to wait for each Modbus response.
data_description.retries: Extra attempts after a timeout, dropped connection or busy reply.
data_description.ihm_request_interval: The iHM protocol requires at least 1.0 s between requests.
data_description.failure_threshold: Consecutive failed polls (or invalid readings for one register) before entities show unavailable. Until then the last good value is kept.
data_description.battery_capacity: Usable battery capacity in kWh. 0 = automatic: use the capacity the hardware reports (iHomeManager register 8147, then inverter registers 13039 and 5639). If none of them report it, Battery stored energy shows unavailable until you enter a value here.
data_description.discharge_efficiency: Factor applied to DC battery discharge in Daily Consumption. Default 0.85.
data_description.spike_max_jump: Grid Import/Export Safe ignore a single step larger than this (kWh). Default 50.
data_description.spike_max_daily: Daily Consumption treats a daily import or export above this as corrupt and uses 0 instead. Default 200.
data_description.spike_rebaseline_count: After this many consecutive, consistent out-of-range readings the Safe meters accept the new value instead of holding the old one forever. Default 3.
